author: kashmunny
quote: Hate to say this, I've bought every GTA since Liberty City and I think they're all very good games but good God what happened to Rockstar here? I did not pay $100 for a girlfriend simulator for a fictional girlfriend I can't even stand. This is not GTA.

author: kashmunny
quote: I picked this game up about a month ago on Amazon for $30 and it's probably the best money I've spent on a game since The Witcher 3. Totally different beast, yes, sandbox-y open space exploration without a lot of structure but tons of fun content for the asking price. This belongs in your switch collection it you're at all remotely interested in the setting.
